boundary: Channel runtime only; unchanged livekit-agents, mode ownership, EOT thresholds, cooldown and timeout budgets. Existing output state machine, buffer and writer are reused.

fixes.problem: A fade ending inside a provider frame replaced its entire unheard tail with zero PCM.
fixes.change: Forward only the fade prefix; read current state/generation again to admit the untouched remainder through the existing buffer/backpressure path. Count forwarded prefix only; fade progression uses samples per channel.
fixes.framework_before_method: Only the prior application _handle_suspended method from f4597dc was restored inside the test process; no SDK or workspace runtime overwrite.
fixes.observed_loss: 60 ms and 200 ms frames failed the preservation test; the 200 ms case silenced about 170 ms after a 30 ms fade.

fixes.problem: Timeout rollback discarded unheard content despite continuing the same reply.
fixes.change: Both bounded evidence expiry and VAD-idle/no-transcript deadline use normal preserve-buffer rollback. Cancellation and explicit discard APIs are unchanged.
fixes.framework_before_state: Fade fix already applied; original timeout-drop decisions still active.
fixes.observed_loss: Default EOT with final 好。 returned 24320 samples for 43200 source samples at 16 kHz before the timeout policy fix; source-count shortfall 1180 ms.

framework_test_boundary: Real AgentSession, Channel and local EOT. Scripted VAD/ASR/LLM/TTS; RecordingAudioOutput checks source PCM and does not simulate RTC queue or physical speaker. Final marker permits only an optional 10 ms trailing zero frame.

previous_errors: RuntimeError: timed out waiting for the previous agent reply to complete before user step '帮我详细介绍一下这个方案'

rtc_content_evidence.boundary: Application buffer counters, not proof that physical playback completed. Benchmark teardown interrupted remaining playout.

limitations: Natural TTS varies between calls. The 174 ms and 1207 ms attenuation observations are not a causal A/B latency comparison or P95.
RTC resume remained about 6.55/6.66 seconds, above original 900 ms gate; no timeout threshold was shortened.
1970 ms buffered audio admitted downstream in about 15 ms. Awaited sink capture is not playout acknowledgement; total downstream queue depth is not measured by this trace.
Preserving content avoids skipping words; it does not prevent an existing timeout decision from resuming while a user is still speaking.
Six known semantic acceptance cases remain expected failures; physical mobile validation deferred by user; no full 300 ms P95 acceptance.
setup_failures_excluded: Worktree EOT/VAD files were Git LFS pointers; reruns used existing hydrated models via environment paths without downloading or modifying model/config files.
Initial diagnostic runpy entrypoint failed macOS process pickling; temporary wrapper changed to import the normal server main. Subsequent real RTC calls verified.
Initial PCM assertion incorrectly excluded AudioEmitter optional 10 ms silent final marker; only that trailing marker was allowed before reporting final content tests.
